_readme: Global assumptions. Values here are defaults; the workload inputs in the app override the workload_defaults block per session.

pue.source: Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey (industry average PUE has hovered ~1.55-1.6 for several years; modern GPU halls are often lower)

electricity_usd_per_kwh.source: US EIA Electric Power Monthly, average industrial retail price (~8-9 c/kWh); commercial rates are higher (~13 c/kWh)

load_factor_pct.source: Average draw as % of nameplate node power. Inference nodes typically run well below max TDP; measure yours.

memory_overhead_pct.source: Rule of thumb for activations, CUDA graphs, framework reserve and fragmentation (vLLM default gpu_memory_utilization is 0.9, i.e. 10% reserved)

support_pct_per_year.source: Typical 3-5 yr hardware support/warranty uplift range 8-15% of hardware cost per year; replace with vendor quote

net_storage_pct_of_servers.source: Allowance for InfiniBand/Ethernet fabric, cabling, and storage. Heavily design-dependent.

net_storage_usd_per_node.source: Alternative per-node allowance (used when net_storage_mode = per_node)

install_usd_per_node.source: One-time rack/stack/integration services per node; off by default

software_usd_per_gpu_per_year.source: Optional inference software subscription per GPU per year (e.g. vendor AI software suites list ~USD 4,500/GPU/yr). Off by default to stay vendor-neutral.

ops_fte.source: Fraction of an FTE attributed to running this cluster; off by default

ops_fte_cost_usd_per_year.source: Fully loaded cost of one infrastructure engineer

residual_value_pct.source: Resale value of hardware at end of term, as % of server capex

financing_rate_pct_per_year.source: Cost of capital applied to capex (0 = paid in cash)

colo_usd_per_kw_month.source: Wholesale/retail colocation, USD per committed kW per month; US market reports range roughly 150-250

kw_per_rack.source: Usable power per rack; air-cooled racks are often 15-40 kW, liquid-cooled much higher

roofline_bandwidth_efficiency_pct.source: Share of peak HBM bandwidth achieved in decode; used ONLY by the theoretical estimate

roofline_compute_efficiency_pct.source: Share of peak dense tensor FLOPS achieved (MFU); used ONLY by the theoretical estimate

workload_defaults._note: Example workload only - not a recommendation: a business-hours internal assistant. peak_concurrent_requests is used only when peak_concurrency_mode = manual.
